summary: This class discusses Aleppo customs for the month of Elul, focusing on Selihot, blowing shofar, and saying Mizmor 27 of Tehillim. It reviews what is found in Mahzor Aram Soba, Shulchan Aruch, and Keter Shem Tob by Hakham Shem Tob Gaguine. It also addresses the distinction between communal practice and what individuals do privately.
subjects: Hakham Shem Tob Gaguine and Keter Shem Tob
questions: At what hour should Selihot be completed according to the custom?
When were Selihot said according to the 1527 Mahzor Aram Soba?
Did the Aleppo community blow shofar during Elul or Selihot?
What does Hakham Shem Tob Gaguine write about blowing shofar before Rosh Hashanah?
Is saying Mizmor 27 from Tehillim after tefillah a communal Halabi practice?
